author: shared-a0
name: T01
source:
theorem T01 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr Scope.Model.trJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeTr N M = m.trJ * M - (m.Du + m.Dv) * N

author: shared-a1
name: T02
source:
theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: shared-a2
name: Q01
source:
theorem Q01 : ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := by
  intro a b c x ha h
  have h2 := Int.sq_nonneg (2*a*x+b)
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (4*a)*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := by grind
  exact Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h1 (by omega)
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c

author: shared-a0
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T01 m N M]
  have a := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h1 h4
  have b := Int.mul_nonneg (by omega : (0:Int) ≤ m.Du + m.Dv) h5
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: shared-a2
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T02]
  have hN : m.S * M * N ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 h3
  have hM2 : 0 < M * M := Int.mul_pos h2 h2
  have hM : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos h1 hM2
  have e1 : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
  have e2 : N ^ 2 = N * N := by grind
  rw [e1, e2]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: shared-a1
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  rw [T02] at h6
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hs
  have hS : 0 ≤ -m.S := by omega
  have a1 : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * N := Int.mul_nonneg hS h5
  have a2 : 0 ≤ ((-m.S) * N) * M := Int.mul_nonneg a1 (by omega)
  have a3 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos h4 h4
    have e : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
    rw [e]; exact this
  have a4 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM2
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

author: shared-a1
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2
  rw [T02]
  have hm : m.S ^ 2 * M ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ * M ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Int.sq_nonneg M)
  have hb : (-(m.S * M)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) := by
    grind
  have h := Q01 (m.Du * m.Dv) (-(m.S * M)) (m.detJ * M ^ 2) N h1 hb
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

author: shared-a0
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T02] at h5
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h6 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := by omega
  have h7 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6 h3
  have hM : M ^ 2 = M * M := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have hN : N ^ 2 = N * N := by simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have h8 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
    rw [hM]
    exact Int.mul_pos h1 (Int.mul_pos h2 h2)
  have e1 : m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 = m.Du * m.Dv * N * N := by
    rw [hN]
    exact (Int.mul_assoc (m.Du * m.Dv) N N).symm
  have e2 : m.S * N * M = m.S * M * N := by
    rw [Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_comm N M]
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

name: H02

theorem H02 : ∀ (r B C : Int), Scope.Favoured r B C ↔ C < r * B := by
  intro r B C

author: shared-a1
name: H01
source:
theorem H01 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 h2
  unfold Scope.hamGain
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C

author: shared-a1
name: H04
source:
theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h hf
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

author: shared-a0
name: H03
source:
theorem H03 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h hB hf
  have h1 := (H02 r₁ B C).1 hf
  apply (H02 r₂ B C).2
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hB
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C

theorem D01 : ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdDD V C < Scope.hdHD V C := by
  intro V C h
  unfold Scope.hdDD Scope.hdHD
  omega
statement: ∀ (V C : Int), 0 < V → Scope.hdDD V C < Scope.hdHD V C

author: shared-a2
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hd hp hDD hS n hn
  have e2 : ∀ x : Int, x ^ 2 = x * x := by
    intro x
    first
      | grind
      | (rw [Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_zero]; simp)
      | simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    rw [e2 p]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have hk : 1 ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    have h1 : (1:Int) ≤ n := by omega
    have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul h1 h1 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [e2]
    simpa using h3
  have h0 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 := Int.mul_nonneg hDD (Int.sq_nonneg s)
  have h2 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk h0
  rw [Int.mul_one] at h2
  have e : m.Du * m.Dv * (Scope.modeN s n) = m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 * (n:Int)^2 := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    grind
  have hS' : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    rw [e]
    unfold Scope.modeM
    exact Int.le_trans hS h2
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ hd hM hN hS' hDD)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

  intro V C
  unfold Scope.hdHH Scope.hdDH

author: shared-a1
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h7 := T08 m N M (Int.mul_pos h2 h3) (Int.not_lt.mp h)
  exact absurd h7 (Int.not_le.mpr h6)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: shared-a2
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD hneg
  rw [T02] at hneg
  have h1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have h2 : (m.detJ * M) * M < (m.S * N) * M := by grind
  exact Int.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h2 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N

author: shared-a1
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7
  exact ⟨T03 m N M h1 h3 h4 h5 h6, T05 m N M h2 h5 h6 h7 (Int.le_of_lt (Int.mul_pos h3 h4))⟩
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)

author: shared-a0
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s h1 hp h3 ⟨n, hn, hd⟩
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    have := Int.mul_pos hp hp
    grind
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) (Int.sq_nonneg _)
  have h := T06 m _ _ h1 hM hN h3 hd
  unfold Scope.modeN Scope.modeM at h
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hn2 : 1 ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    grind
  have k : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * ((n:Int)^2 * s^2 - s^2) := by
    apply Int.mul_nonneg h3
    have := Int.mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (n:Int)^2 - 1 by omega) (Int.sq_nonneg s)
    grind
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2
